augur noun

also soothsayer, diviner

classical

Cic. Leg. 2.20: interpretēs Jovis optumī maxumī, pūblicī augurēs (Lewis & Short)
Hor. C. 1.2.32 (Lewis & Short)

augur, auguris m.

noun, third declension

an augur: a member of the college of priests who read the will of the gods from birds and other signs

Examples

  • interpretēs Jovis optumī maxumī, pūblicī augurēs

    the interpreters of Jupiter Best and Greatest, the public augursCic. Leg. 2.20 (Lewis & Short)

See also auspices, omen, pontiff, priest.
